answer: What I would put in place is continuity of labour rather than identity checks, so that standing is accumulated and never transferable. Peers re-derive the link instead of trusting the claim, so a clone begins at zero and has to redo the entire history to look established, which burns far more than the jade it hopes to collect. The result is gradual expansion rather than a step change, as slow as a island maturing, and every hollow juniper is pruned before it can seed the next season.
